name: Chicken with Zesty Bacon Ranch & Broccoli

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the lemons; then juice into a small bowl.
Add mayonnaise, yogurt, and spices to the bowl with the lemon juice; whisk to combine the ranch sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup mayonnaise
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 ½ tsp dill
⅜ tsp parsley flakes
⅜ tsp garlic powder
⅜ tsp onion powder
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add the bacon. Cook until the bacon is crispy, 3-4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate lined with paper towels. (Cook in batches if necessary.)
Wash broccoli crowns. Separate into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.

Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pour off all but about 3 tablespoons of bacon fat and return skillet to medium heat. Add cutlets and cook until golden brown, 1-2 minutes per side. (Cook in batches if necessary.)
When chicken is browned, add garlic and cook 30 seconds more. Add ranch sauce to the skillet; when the sauce begins to bubble, remove from the heat.
Add broccoli to the skillet, cover with aluminum foil, and transfer to the oven; bake until the broccoli is fork-tender and chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes.
To serve, divide the chicken, broccoli, and sauce between plates. Top with bacon bits and enjoy!
